fields.description: Save format version marker. Boot init (FUN_08001434) default-writes 5; validators require exactly 5.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001434 requires u16 at SRAM 0x0E000000+0 == 5 (-(*buf ^ 5) >> 31) and default-writes 5; FUN_08001540 re-checks *param == 5. Baseline holds 5.
fields.name: save_format_version

fields.description: Reserved padding byte; validators require it to be zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001434 rejects the header if (char)buf_u16[1] (save+2) != 0; FUN_08001540 re-checks (char)param[1] == 0; init writes 0. Baseline is 0x00.
fields.name: header_pad_zero

fields.description: Header status flag. Validators require nonzero (0x00 = freshly initialized / inactive). No upper bound is checked in decomp, so no constraint is set.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001434 marks header invalid if *(char*)(buf+3) == 0; FUN_08001540 requires *(char*)(buf+3) != 0 for validity; init default-writes 0. Baseline 0x00 explains why the captured boot rewrote defaults.
fields.name: save_active_flag

fields.description: Reserved 32-bit header word, default-written as 0 by boot init and ignored by the header validators. Layout position matches the stack slot compared against the FUN_080014ec table byte-sum in FUN_0800159c, so it may hold an extended-data checksum once gameplay saves; semantics unconfirmed, hence no constraint.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001434 writes u32 0 at save+4 via *(u32*)(wbuf+2) = 0; header validators in FUN_08001434/FUN_08001540 never read save+4..7; FUN_0800159c compares its stack word over save+4..7 (iStack_1c over the 0x10-byte header) to FUN_080014ec(). Baseline is 0.
fields.name: header_check_or_reserved

fields.description: Fixed game magic ASCII 'AGB-HARO' identifying this title's SRAM header.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001434/FUN_08001540 memcmp save+8..15 against the 8-byte ROM magic referenced via DAT_08001498/DAT_08001574; FUN_08001434 restores it from ROM (DAT_080014e4) on init. Baseline bytes 8..15 decode to AGB-HARO.
fields.name: game_magic_agb_haro

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'AGB-HARO' game magic at header offset 8
